lessons_learned: Always run targeted tests after any DI change — new dependencies break existing tests silently
Flutter Web build artifacts (build/) can accumulate 1.1GB+ on disk — check during daily analysis
AGENTS.md must be audited for accuracy each run — stale port numbers, missing modules, dead tool references are common
When adding injectable dependencies to an existing service, ALL test files for that service must be updated with the new mock provider
Fruit persistence (FruitRepository) added to PublicApiService — getFruits() now queries DB, not proxying to fruityvice.com
Speech recognition rewrite (commit d751c52) replaces the speech_to_text plugin with a platform-aware abstraction — Web uses native Web Speech API, mobile uses the plugin
Quiz TTS now auto-reads questions & options with voice feedback on answers — requires no additional API calls
Game animations added: fade+slide quiz transitions, floating emoji decorations in country matching, leftTitle/rightTitle labels in matching games

Test regressions from prod fixes: ai.service.core.spec.ts expected old listSessions params (childId:2), reward.service.spec.ts used date >30 days ago (makeup validation), poetry.service.spec.ts expected simplified Chinese but OpenCC converts to traditional (zh-Hant lang)
pi-ai multi-provider migration: @earendil-works/pi-ai is ESM-only — must use dynamic import. Fallback to OpenAI SDK works when pi-ai fails to load.
Content import script (import-content-json.py) enables batch loading of 47 curriculum JSON files into lingxi.db — run after each content update.

backend/public/ still held 91MB of stale Flutter Web build artifacts (canvaskit, assets, main.dart.js) — nginx serves from frontend/build/web/ directly, so backend/public/ Flutter artifacts are dead weight.

sql.js fallback with autoSave: true + explicit database path now prevents data loss when better-sqlite3 fails to load. The old in-memory-only sql.js config caused registered users to vanish and API-created data to be invisible.
lesson_pack nested content structure appears in curriculum JSON — content_detail screen must unwrap { type: 'lesson_pack', content: [...] } to access quizzes and text sections.
Mobile video download on Android requires WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE with maxSdkVersion=28 (scoped storage in Android 10+). share_plus plugin enables native share sheet after download.
The deployed Flutter Web (main.dart.v4.js) is out of date — local build is v5.js with 5 new Flutter commits since last deploy. bootstrap.js references v4 on CDN, v5 locally.
